label: Demo proposed road network (synthetic)
source: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA -- invented roads at invented coordinates. Not derived from any real master plan. Offsets are chosen so distances from (17.0 N, 79.0 E) come out in round metres.
note: 45M=100m E, 60M=20m N (encroaches), 30M=500m S, 90M=1500m N, 24M stub starts 300m E (endpoint case), one segment has no width.
